title: A Comprehensive Survey on Linguistic Steganography: Methods, Countermeasures, Evaluation, and Challenges
abstract: arXiv:2608.29077v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linguistic steganography hides secret messages in natural language text. Large language models (LLMs) have reshaped the field, but a systematic account of how these scattered advances collectively reshape the field in this new era is still missing. We provide one along four axes: 148 steganographic methods, 60 linguistic steganalysis countermeasures, 23 evaluation metrics, and 9 open challenges, each with taxonomies, reviews, and adoption analyses. Cutting across these axes, we identify five specific paradigm shifts in the LLM era: (1) from covertext modification to prompt-only generation, (2) from heuristic to provable security, (3) from white-box symmetric LMs to black-box or asymmetric access, (4) from security-centric designs to joint optimization, and (5) from text-quality concerns to engineering issues. The survey aims to serve as both a reference and a roadmap for practical and responsible linguistic steganography in the LLM era

translated_title: 语言隐写术综合综述：方法、对策、评估与挑战
translated_abstract: 语言隐写术将秘密信息隐藏在自然语言文本之中。大型语言模型（LLM）已经重塑了这一领域，但对于这些分散的进展如何在新时代共同重塑该领域，目前仍缺乏系统性的论述。我们从四个维度提供了这样的论述：148种隐写方法、60种语言隐写分析对策、23种评估指标以及9个开放性挑战，每个维度都包含分类体系、综述和采用情况分析。贯穿这些维度，我们识别出LLM时代的五个具体范式转变：（1）从载体文本修改到仅通过提示词生成，（2）从启发式安全到可证明安全，（3）从白盒对称语言模型到黑盒或非对称访问，（4）从以安全为中心的设计到联合优化，（5）从文本质量问题到工程问题。本综述旨在作为LLM时代实用且负责任的语言隐写术的参考和路线图。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了LLM时代的语言隐写术，涵盖148种隐写方法、60种隐写分析对策、23种评估指标和9个开放挑战，并识别出五个关键范式转变，为该领域提供参考与路线图。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically reviews linguistic steganography in the LLM era, covering 148 steganographic methods, 60 steganalysis countermeasures, 23 evaluation metrics, and 9 open challenges, while identifying five key paradigm shifts to serve as a reference and roadmap for the field.
